item.title: The 17-Year-Old Who Vanished After a Mysterious Phone Call!
item.description: Nathaniel Holmes disappeared in December 2017 after leaving his Colorado high school and telling his mother he was meeting a friend of his father's. He never contacted his family again, and his disappearance remains unsolved.
